newsitem.title: USA: PG Energy to buy Honesdale Gas.
newsitem.headline: PG Energy to buy Honesdale Gas.

text.p: PG Energy said Thursday it agreed to acquire the Honesdale Gas Co for undisclosed terms.

The utility subsidiary of Pennsylvania Enterprises Inc said Honesdale Gas serves about 3,200 customers in portions of Wayne and Pike counties in northeastern Pennsylvania including Honesdale, Hawley and Milford. Natural gas is supplied to the company through two city gate stations, or connections, with Tenneco Inc's [TEN.N] Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co interstate pipeline at Honesdale and Milford.

"This acquisition provides PG Energy with an opportunity to operate in the growing Pocono Mountain region of Pennsylvania which is adjacent to our existing service territory. It is a natural extension for our company and positions PG Energy for extensive future growth, particularly in Pike County which is the fastest-growing county in the state," the company said. It now provides natural gas to about 142,000 customers in ten northeastern Pennsylvania counties.
It said the purchase, which is subject to approval by the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission, is expected to be completed by early next year.
